levelDesc: Kurikulum 10 bab baku mengacu pada standar Cambridge A1 untuk penguasaan struktur SVO, tenses dasar, dan kosa kata akademis pemula.

lessons.title: Subject Pronouns & Simple Present 'To Be'
lessons.rule: Aturan baku: I am, You/We/They are, He/She/It is. Gunakan untuk menyatakan identitas, profesi, atau kondisi.
lessons.examples: Contoh: 'I am a student' | 'She is a manager' | 'They are ready'
lessons.audioText: I am a student. She is a manager. They are ready.

lessons.title: Simple Present Action Verbs (SVO Structure)
lessons.rule: Pola SVO: Subjek + Kata Kerja Utama (+s/es untuk He/She/It) + Objek untuk kebiasaan harian.
lessons.examples: Contoh: 'I study English' | 'He works in an office'
lessons.audioText: I study English every day. He works in an office.

lessons.title: Present Continuous Tense (Action in Progress)
lessons.rule: Pola: Subjek + To Be (am/is/are) + Verb-ing. Digunakan untuk kejadian yang sedang berlangsung saat ini.
lessons.examples: Contoh: 'I am writing a report' | 'They are studying now'
lessons.audioText: I am writing a report right now. They are studying.

lessons.title: Articles (A, An, The) & Singular/Plural Nouns
lessons.rule: Gunakan 'an' sebelum bunyi vokal (a, e, i, o, u) dan 'a' untuk konsonan. Tambahkan -s/-es untuk kata benda jamak.
lessons.audioText: I have an apple and two computers.

questions.target: Pilih artikel yang tepat: ' Dia membeli ___ apel.'

lessons.title: Possessive Adjectives (My, Your, His, Her, Their)
lessons.rule: Kata ganti kepemilikan yang wajib diikuti kata benda: my book, your team, his car, her project, their office.
lessons.examples: Contoh: 'This is my project' | 'Her office is clean'
lessons.audioText: This is my project and her office is clean.

lessons.title: Prepositions of Place & Time (In, On, At)
lessons.rule: At: waktu/lokasi spesifik (at 7 AM, at school). On: hari/permukaan (on Monday, on the table). In: bulan/tahun/ruangan (in May, in the room).
lessons.examples: Contoh: 'The meeting is at 9 AM' | 'I live in Indonesia'
lessons.audioText: The meeting is at nine AM on Monday.

questions.target: Buku itu ada di atas meja.

lessons.title: Modal Verb 'Can' for Ability & Requests
lessons.rule: Pola: Subjek + can + Kata Kerja Dasar (Verb 1). Digunakan untuk menyatakan kemampuan atau meminta izin.
lessons.examples: Contoh: 'I can speak English' | 'Can you help me?'
lessons.audioText: I can speak English clearly. Can you help me?

lessons.title: Simple Past Tense (Completed Past Actions)
lessons.rule: Gunakan Was/Were untuk kondisi masa lalu, atau Verb-2 (Regular: -ed) untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai.
lessons.examples: Contoh: 'I visited the museum yesterday' | 'She was busy'
lessons.audioText: I visited the museum yesterday. She was busy.

lessons.title: Wh- Questions (What, Where, When, Who, Why, How)
lessons.rule: Struktur pertanyaan: Wh- Word + Auxiliary Verb (do/does/is/are) + Subjek + Kata Kerja Utama.
lessons.examples: Contoh: 'Where do you live?' | 'What is your plan?'
lessons.audioText: Where do you live? What is your daily plan?

lessons.title: Adjectives & Basic Professional Vocabulary
lessons.rule: Kata sifat diletakkan SEBELUM kata benda: 'a clean room', 'an efficient system', 'a successful project'.
lessons.examples: Contoh: 'This is a successful project' | 'The analysis is clear'
lessons.audioText: This is an efficient system and a successful project.
